title: ENiGMA½ BBS configuration
$comment:
Generated by "npm run build:schema" from core/config_default.js and core/config/meta.js. Do not edit by hand.

Describes the file as ENiGMA½ sees it, after loading: "@reference:",
"@environment:" and "@file:" specs are substituted before this applies, so
an unresolved spec in the raw file may read as a type error here while
being perfectly correct.

Nothing is "required": a file may be a fragment completed by "includes",
and in config.hjson's case by the defaults.

Where this says "additionalProperties": false, ENiGMA½ itself only warns.
It never refuses to boot over a key it does not recognise.

boardName.description: Name of the board. Also what FTN packets and NNTP responses identify this system as.

prettyBoardName.description: Board name for display; may contain pipe colour codes.

telnetHostname.description: Hostname shown to users for telnet. Advertised only -- it does not affect what the server binds.

sshHostname.description: Hostname shown to users for SSH. Advertised only -- it does not affect what the server binds.

description.description: One line describing the board, used where a summary is wanted.

menuFile.description: Menu configuration file. Relative names resolve against the config directory.

achievementFile.description: Achievement configuration file. Relative names resolve against the config directory.

maxConnections.description: Simultaneous connections allowed across every login server. 0 for unlimited.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the board, e.g. 'en-US'. Reported to doors; ENiGMA½ itself is not translated.

configValidation.description: Report configuration problems at startup and on reload, or stay silent.

checkUtf8Encoding.description: Detect UTF-8 by cursor position report. Costs a 2 second connect delay on terminals that do not answer.

checkAnsiHomePosition.description: Detect non-standard positioning by cursor position report. Costs a 3 second connect delay on terminals that do not answer.

cp437TermList.description: Terminal types assumed to be CP437 without probing.

utf8TermList.description: Terminal types assumed to be UTF-8 without probing.

forceOutputEncoding.description: Force an output encoding rather than autodetecting; null to autodetect.

usernamePattern.description: Regular expression, as a string, that a new user name must match.

requireActivation.description: New accounts stay inactive until the sysop activates them.

newUserNames.description: Names that start the new user application instead of a login.

preAuthIdleLogoutSeconds.description: Idle timeout before login. 0 never disconnects.

idleLogoutSeconds.description: Idle timeout once logged in. 0 never disconnects.

timeLimits.description: Daily time allowance bands, in minutes. Ordered; first ACS match wins, an entry with no acs is the default, and no match means unlimited.

unlimitedTimeText.description: What the TR and TA MCI codes render when no limit applies.

disconnect.description: Failed attempts in one session before the connection is dropped. 0 never drops.

lockAccount.description: Failed attempts before the account is locked. 0 never locks.

autoUnlockMinutes.description: Unlock a locked account after this long. 0 requires the sysop to unlock it.

unlockAtEmailPwReset.description: A successful password reset by email also unlocks a locked account.

method.description: One time password scheme offered for two factor authentication.

default.description: Theme for logged in users: a directory name under paths.themes, or "*" to pick one at random.

preLogin.description: Theme used before login: a directory name under paths.themes, or "*" to pick one at random.

passwordChar.description: Character echoed in place of a password.

long.default: ddd, MMMM Do, YYYY, h:mm a

firstMenu.description: Menu entered on connect; must name an entry in menu.hjson.

address.description: Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.

privateKeyPem.description: Host key in traditional PEM form; a modern OpenSSH key will not load.

firstMenu.description: Menu entered on connect; must name an entry in menu.hjson.

firstMenuNewUser.description: Menu entered when connecting as one of users.newUserNames; must name an entry in menu.hjson.

address.description: Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.
Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.
Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.

proxied.description: Trust X-Forwarded-For when behind a reverse proxy.

domain.description: Domain this board is reached at; used to build links in email and on the web.

level.description: Lowest severity written to the web server log.

address.description: Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.
Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.

overrideUrlPrefix.description: Replaces the derived scheme://host prefix in generated URLs.

publicPort.description: Port advertised in Gopher selectors, for when the board is reached through a forward.

address.description: Interface to bind to. Unset binds every interface.

publicMessageConferences.description: Conferences and areas exposed to anonymous NNTP users, as confTag -> [ areaTag, ... ].

multiplexerPort.description: Local port the MRC multiplexer listens on for this board.

maxMessages.description: Messages kept per area before the oldest are trimmed. 0 keeps everything.

maxAgeDays.description: Age at which messages are trimmed. 0 keeps everything.

fromDomain.description: Domain used for generated From addresses; null falls back to defaultFrom.

secure.description: Connect with TLS from the start, as port 993 expects.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll for new mail. 0 uses IMAP IDLE instead of polling.

maxMessagesPerRun.description: Messages processed per pass, so a large backlog cannot stall a run.

retain.description: Copy processed packets here; debugging aid.

packetTargetByteSize.description: Start a new packet once the current one passes this size.

bundleTargetByteSize.description: Start a new bundle once the current one passes this size.

packetMsgEncoding.description: Encoding for exported message text, e.g. "cp437" or "utf8".

packetAnsiMsgEncoding.description: Encoding for exported messages containing ANSI art.

secureInOnly.description: Import only from the secure inbound, never the unsecure one.

uploadBy.description: Uploader name recorded against files imported from a TIC.

allowReplace.description: Honour a TIC's Replaces field and remove the file it names.

descPriority.description: Where a file description comes from: "diz" prefers a FILE_ID.DIZ inside the file, "tic" prefers the TIC's own Ldesc.

holdMaxAgeMs.description: How long a TIC whose file has not arrived is held before being rejected.

fileCase.description: Case of generated packet and bundle file names.

addressDimensions.description: Address form written into generated TICs. Seenby is always 4D regardless.

pullSchedule.description: When to poll uplinks for waiting mail, in the same syntax as eventScheduler.

defaultNetwork.description: Network whose outbound goes in the unsuffixed directory; null for none.

anyOf.$comment: Shorthand: a bare scalar names this block's primary field.

areaStoragePrefix.description: Directory a relative storage tag path is resolved against.

expireMinutes.description: How long a generated web download link stays valid.

storageTags.description: Maps a storage tag to a directory holding that area's files.

fileName.description: Log file name, created under paths.logs.

level.description: Lowest severity written to the log.

loginHistoryMax.description: Login history entries kept. -1 keeps everything.

includes.description: Additional hjson files merged into this configuration.

bbsID.description: Packet ID: the 1-8 character root name every file in a Blue Wave packet shares.

originLine.description: Origin line appended to exported FTN messages.
